parsed.note_markdown:
### TFC — Strategic repositioning drives reported EPS sharply lower

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS fell to $0.56 from $1.23 in 2Q26**, a $0.67 sequential decline. Adjusted EPS was $1.16, down from $1.23, after excluding specified repositioning and loan-sale impacts [B0025, B0026]. Reported net income available to common shareholders was $684 million [B0348].

**EPS drivers:** The AFS securities repositioning generated a $0.90 per-share loss. The RAC loan sale produced a $0.36 per-share reserve recapture and a further $0.06 positive per-share impact. Management excluded these impacts when presenting adjusted earnings [B0049, B0050].

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII increased to $3,663 million from $3,621 million, and FTE NIM improved to 3.00% from 2.98%. Reported noninterest income plunged to $84 million from $1,644 million because of repositioning and loan-sale effects. Expenses increased to $3,105 million from $3,055 million [B0338, B0077, B0108, B0129, B0053].

**Credit:** The reported provision was a $253 million benefit, including a $581 million reserve release associated with the RAC transaction. Net charge-offs reached $629 million, with 39 basis points of the 0.77% charge-off ratio attributed to RAC [B0203, B0206, B0204, B0058].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 was 10.7%; reported ROTCE was 7.2% versus adjusted ROTCE of 14.6%. Buybacks totaled $1.2 billion [B0176, B0030, B0031, B0182].

**Outlook:** Management projected approximately $5.35 billion of fourth-quarter taxable-equivalent revenue and a charge-off ratio near 0.45% [B0991].

**Investment thesis:** Mixed. Repositioning may improve prospective earnings, but underlying EPS softened and transaction execution remains central to the thesis.
